LanguageData.ABY_GatebreakerSpiker.label: gatebreaker spiker
LanguageData.ABY_GatebreakerSpiker.description: A heavy breach-spike cannon built to match the Gatebreaker suit line. Its black segmented frame holds a predatory maw-reactor that bites open a narrow rupture and throws a single white-hot spike through armor, boss shells and hardened breach constructs. It is too slow for crowd control, but devastating when one target absolutely must be cracked.
